scope: Independent non-ChemCam LIBS sources with numerical spectra, real chemical/method/matrix blanks or independently characterized low Fe/Mg standards, explicit data reuse rights, and air/vacuum wavelength convention.
interpretation: This is a bounded source audit, not proof that suitable data do not exist. Several papers report real blank measurements; none of the inspected sources establishes every required property for Fe/Mg validation.
required_before_admission: Public numerical wavelength/intensity files with sample/control identifiers and a verified data license.
Explicit wavelength units and air/vacuum convention, independently documented rather than inferred from acquisition atmosphere.
Independent Fe/Mg composition or element-specific upper bounds for the measured blank/standard, with units, method and uncertainty/detection limits where applicable.
Provenance connecting each numerical spectrum to the independently characterized material and actual blank preparation.
Physical material, family, preparation batch and session grouping; overlap with previously used materials checked before splitting.
Freeze selection and any development/test allocation before inspecting prediction scores or new final intensities.

candidates.title: Influence of sample matrix and filter fixation on LIBS signal in analysis of algae on filter

license.note: Dataset rights differ from article rights; verified separately.

axis.note: Echelle coverage and line assignments do not establish the wavelength convention of deposited files.

blank.note: Filter rim outside the filtration area is a real substrate/matrix control. Unspiked algae are not an element-free blank.

chemical_limits.note: Independent analysis finds nonzero blank/control composition despite weak LIBS signals. No element-specific Fe/Mg blank upper bounds confirmed.

independence.note: Tape-layer variants and repeated shots are not independent physical samples.

candidates.next_evidence: Obtain repository file metadata/control mapping, wavelength convention and the independent Fe/Mg assay for each blank type before selecting spectra.

candidates.title: Mount Holyoke College Laser Induced Breakdown Spectra; SuperLIBS 10K; Earth and vacuum atmospheres

axis.note: Vacuum in the dataset title identifies chamber conditions, not wavelength calibration convention.

blank.note: Known-composition reference targets are documented; no explicit chemical blank or reagent purity bounds established in inspected metadata.

chemical_limits.note: Target chemistry is described as known. A target-specific low Fe/Mg certificate was not verified here.

independence.note: Check shared standard materials against ChemCam/PDS inventories before claiming independent evaluation.

candidates.next_evidence: Inspect only repository manifests and independent composition certificates first; keep acquisition-atmosphere variants grouped by physical target.

candidates.title: Soil/ore LIBS classification benchmark with OREAS compositions

axis.note: Air acquisition does not establish an air-wavelength axis.

blank.note: Inspected methods describe ore materials and mixtures, not a measured chemical blank.

chemical_limits.independent_method: vendor OREAS reference compositions reported by authors
chemical_limits.note: Derived mixture tables can turn missing source entries into zero plus/minus zero. Gypsum binder is excluded from reported mixture composition; neither case establishes chemical absence.

independence.note: Repeated shots and mixtures sharing reference parents cannot be treated as independent materials.

candidates.next_evidence: A low-Mg standard lead exists; require original certificates, preparation/binder chemistry and an explicit axis convention before any spectral intake.

candidates.title: Rapid automatic detection of calcium and magnesium in water by LIBS

blank.note: Acid-treated and deionized-water-washed membrane provides a real substrate control; no observable LIBS signal is not independent chemical evidence.

chemical_limits.note: Nominal zero and LIBS detection limits do not certify residual Fe/Mg in the complete prepared blank.

independence.note: Multiple positions on one membrane are technical replicates.

candidates.next_evidence: A future authorized author request would need numerical blank spectra, complete preparation chemistry, axis metadata and explicit reuse rights.

candidates.title: Detection and classification of bacterial cells after centrifugation and filtration by LIBS

blank.note: The water control passes through the same centrifugation/filtration procedure. It is a real method blank, but small Mg/Ca/Na lines are observed.

chemical_limits.note: Bacterial absence labels do not imply elemental absence; no independent Fe/Mg impurity bound confirmed.

independence.note: Repeated single-shot spectra on one filter are not independent chemical controls.

availability.supplement: PDF tables and spectral ratios; no public numerical raw-spectra archive identified

candidates.next_evidence: Use as a method-blank protocol reference only until numerical files and independent chemistry are supplied.

candidates.title: Blank sample denoising algorithm for LIBS water analysis

blank.note: The abstract describes a self-built blank spectral database; this does not establish an accessible numerical archive.

chemical_limits.note: Trace purity bounds for the deionized water were not verified; Fe is not among the listed analytes.

candidates.next_evidence: Locate an actual licensed repository and independent blank characterization before considering this source for validation.

candidates.title: Sparge Sampling of Molten Salts for Online Monitoring by Laser-Induced Breakdown Spectroscopy

blank.note: Blank independently checked by ICP-OES, providing a useful analytical-control precedent.

chemical_limits.note: The blank is reported below those Sr/Li limits; these bounds cannot be transferred to Fe/Mg.

availability.supplement: PDF methods/calibration information, not a verified numerical spectrum archive

candidates.next_evidence: Retain as a protocol precedent; target-specific Fe/Mg independent chemistry would still be required.

candidates.title: LIBS-LIA-FSRF marine salt aerosol dataset

blank.note: NaCl, CaCl2, MgSO4 and KCl aerosols are described; no explicit reagent/method blank established.

chemical_limits.note: Nominal salt formulas do not certify absence of Mg/Fe contamination or provide impurity upper bounds.

availability.processing: Repository describes normalization/PCA; raw-versus-processed file contents were not inspected.

candidates.next_evidence: Seek reagent certificates and a metadata-only inventory of numerical columns and real blank records.

candidates.title: Direct LIBS Analysis of Estuarine Suspended Particulate Matter Collected on Filters

blank.note: Blank filters measured under matching LIBS conditions show substrate elemental emission. Treated as a constant contribution, not chemical absence.

chemical_limits.note: Environmental Fe/Mg signals and their salinity trends do not supply an independent blank impurity certificate.

independence.note: 1820 shots per filter are averaged; the filter is the physical sample.

availability.data_statement: Article states all generated/analyzed data are included; supplement ZIP is listed but was not inspected.

candidates.next_evidence: Verify supplement inventory without opening intensity data, then require independent blank chemistry and an explicit axis convention.

candidates.title: Calibration strategies for direct determination of Ca, K and Mg in powder samples by LIBS

blank.note: Cellulose blank is included in calibration mixtures, a real material control rather than an electronic dark measurement.

chemical_limits.independent_method: ICP-OES comparison samples; independent blank bounds not established
chemical_limits.note: LIBS LOQ is a performance statistic, not an independently measured cellulose impurity upper bound. Nominal blank zero is not strict absence.

candidates.next_evidence: Require measured numerical blank spectra, reagent certificate/independent assay, explicit data rights and wavelength convention.

candidates.title: Laser-Induced Breakdown Spectroscopy Dataset for Planetary Materials Analysis

blank.note: No explicit chemical/method blank established from the official catalogue; the detailed guide could not be fetched.

chemical_limits.note: Independent composition CSVs are listed; their contents and provenance were not retrieved. No impurity certificate or blank upper bound is established.

independence.note: Official temporal coverage is 2010-11-25 through 2010-11-29; distinct dates alone do not establish independent materials.

candidates.next_evidence: Obtain the small guide and composition metadata from the official host, then establish wavelength convention, material matching and actual blank assays before spectral intake.

candidates.title: Spectral Analysis of Minerals with Handheld LIBS Technology

blank.note: Pure mineral spectra are described, not certified method/matrix blanks.

chemical_limits.note: Metadata description lists mineral chemical formulas; a formula is not an independent trace-impurity assay or absence certificate.

independence.note: Measurements span 2021-2023; multiple points/spectra on one mineral require physical grouping.

candidates.next_evidence: Inspect the metadata file and independent certificates; do not derive negative labels from ideal mineral formulas.
